title: Confirm 确认框
description: 请用户确认某个操作，可替代 window.confirm 并跟随主题。可使用声明式的 ConfirmDialog，或在任意位置 await confirm()：挂载了 ConfirmProvider 时弹窗渲染在应用树内，没有时按需挂载独立宿主，服务端调用 confirm() 恒定返回 false。

usage.title: 如何选择：useConfirm() 还是 confirm()
usage.hook: 在组件内调用 useConfirm()：它的对话框跟随最近的 ConfigProvider 作用域。在嵌套 Provider 下，模态框渲染到该作用域的 portal 容器中，使用其主题、配色方案和 token，默认按钮文案使用其语言。存在 ConfirmProvider 时仍由它渲染。
usage.function: 在 React 之外（事件总线、API 客户端、路由守卫等非组件模块）直接导入 confirm()：那里无法使用 hook，其对话框使用根主题和根语言。

wc:minerva-confirm-dialog.summary: Modal confirmation dialog (alertdialog) with localized Confirm / Cancel buttons.
wc:minerva-confirm-dialog.description: Confirmation dialog (`<ConfirmDialog>` of React): a small modal `alertdialog` asking the user to confirm an action, a themed replacement for `window.confirm`. Focus moves to the Cancel button (the least destructive action, WAI-ARIA APG) and is trapped; Escape (topmost layer only), an overlay click, the Cancel and the close (×) buttons cancel; focus returns to the opener on close. Pressing Confirm fires a cancelable `minerva-confirm`, runs the optional `onConfirm` callback (a returned promise shows the loading state until it settles; a rejection keeps the dialog open) and closes the dialog. For the imperative `confirm({ title }) -> Promise<boolean>` API, see `confirm()` (exported by the same entry).

wc:minerva-confirm-provider.summary: Scope that renders the imperative confirm() dialogs of its subtree (ConfirmProvider).
wc:minerva-confirm-provider.description: Renders the imperative confirmations of its subtree (the React library's `ConfirmProvider`): `confirm({ host })` / `confirmFor(host)` called with an element inside it are queued here and their dialogs are appended inside it (or inside the host's nested `<minerva-config>` scope), so they use its theme, palette and language. `confirm()` without a host uses the most recently connected provider. Disconnecting the provider cancels its pending confirmations (they resolve `false`). Optional: without a provider, confirmations render on `document.body`. It renders as `display: contents`.

properties.name: confirm
properties.description: Asks for a confirmation rendered by this provider (its scope, or the scope of `options.host`); resolves `true` when confirmed.

examples.description: confirm({ host })（或 confirmFor(host)）等价于 useConfirm()：对话框渲染在 host 所在的 <minerva-config> 作用域内（深色、tech 调色板、中文标签），并由最近的 <minerva-confirm-provider> 排队。不带 host 的 confirm() 渲染在 provider 自身的作用域中（这里是根主题和语言），与全局 confirm() 相同。

provider.description: useConfirm() 返回由该 Provider 渲染的 confirm（位于调用方的 ConfigProvider 作用域中），弹窗共享应用的 context。并发请求按顺序逐个显示。

declarative.title: 声明式 ConfirmDialog
declarative.description: 受控弹窗；loading 在 onConfirm 执行期间显示加载动画并禁用取消。

scoped.title: 作用域：useConfirm() 与 confirm()
scoped.description: 两个按钮都位于嵌套的 ConfigProvider 中（暗色主题、tech 配色、中文）。useConfirm() 在该作用域中打开对话框（暗色 token、中文按钮文案）；confirm() 在根部打开，使用页面的主题和语言。

ConfirmDialogProps.onOpenChange: 用户取消时以 false 调用（取消按钮、关闭、Escape、点击遮罩）
ConfirmDialogProps.onConfirm: 点击确认按钮时调用；弹窗不会自行关闭
